name: OMathAutoCorrectEntries
description: Represents a collection of math AutoCorrect entries. Use the OMathAutoCorrectEntry object to access individual AutoCorrect entries.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathAutoCorrectEntries object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the OMathAutoCorrectEntries collection. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an OMathAutoCorrectEntry object that represents the specified item in the collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies a String or Integer that represents the name or ordinal position of the object in the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Name As String, Value As String) As OMathAutoCorrectEntry
methods.description: Creates an equation auto correct entry and returns an OMathAutoCorrectEntry object.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the autocorrect entry. Corresponds to the Name property of the OMathAutoCorrectEntry object.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The value of the autocorrect entry. Corresponds to the Value property of the OMathAutoCorrectEntry object.
